purpose: Static educational illustrations for the Hong Kong Financial Report Analyst project guide
delivery: Local WebP assets. Original generated PNGs are retained in the generation library. No runtime generation.

images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: permanently embedded concept illustration for a bilingual finance-learning web app. Create a wide landscape editorial illustration, roughly 3:2, with a warm ivory background, deep ink outlines, teal and mint with restrained amber accents, soft paper texture, clean friendly cut-paper / softly dimensional textbook style. Audience: a software developer learning to build a Hong Kong financial-report analyst. Draw ONE clear connected visual journey, five large illustrated stations left to right with thin directional arrows: (1) a stack of public company annual-report PDFs with a small Hong Kong skyline motif; (2) a careful extraction desk taking table cells out of a report while keeping a page bookmark; (3) a tidy financial ledger with attached tags for currency, year and source page; (4) a question bubble, evidence magnifying glass and calculator working together; (5) an analyst comparing a chart to the original bookmarked report and approving a cited research brief. Make the report source visibly remain linked to the ledger and final brief, and depict the human checking evidence, not a magic AI producing truth. Minimal embedded text: only the five large station numbers '1', '2', '3', '4', '5'; no other words, letters, fake text, logos or watermarks. No investment recommendations, no real company logos or real financial data. Keep generous margins and large simple recognizable objects; image should be understandable at 700px width. Stations must be separated clearly so translated HTML captions can be displayed underneath. Professional approachable educational illustration, not a UI screenshot, no dense diagram or decorative filler.
